# Conditional interval coverage and remaining gaps

CONDITIONAL STATUS MAINTENANCE ONLY. No new paper, accepted result, Tool,
independent review, author contribution to the new candidate, or Source.
Every inclusion using the new interval below has the explicit premise:
IF the new three-author COMMON candidate actually passes its whole review.
Its UNFROZEN proof was not received, read or repaired by CF. The candidate
is not entered into accepted coverage by this note.

Same CF actor/key/current12/27; historical FREE registration, directed TASK
semantics, old failure/false ending and cumulative budget UNKNOWN remain.
Fresh own actual12 at main909685669cc7fe702189b8aa8e0372ec6ea2c8da:
original startup exit0, debt[], authorized=false, bookkeeping-only, all
five authority flags false. No scientific program, enumeration, solver,
Native call, Source mutation or checkpoint13 was run. Comparisons below
are paper inequalities between integer endpoints, not numerical samples.

## Inputs and attribution

All intervals concern the SAME H_d^raw, d=m^2-3 and integer j in [0,d].
The accepted scopes below are Root-attributed data from the named 5714 /
KB a731 continuity records, not claims that CF newly audited all proofs:

| Input | m cutoff | Guaranteed integer interval |
|---|---:|---|
| Initial, earlier | 7 | [0,floor(m/6)] |
| Initial, completed gap corollary | 2^1000 | [0,6m] |
| Directional | 2^1000 | [4m,6m] |
| Log upper | 2^100000 | [ceil(10000d/ln m),d] |
| Quarter bulk | 2^100000 | [ceil(d/4),floor(3d/4)] |
| Terminal | 10000 | [ceil(99999d/100000),d] |

CF previously personally completely read the initial-gap author3 at
1e0bb6f1ddb7a8bea3cfc84ad0ec6c2804119829 and its true peer2 at
ca2b67f9c67fbe58aacfc8923e2d42ae109ef296. Those are reused prior inputs,
not new remote whole reads. For log notation only, A gave an exact OLD
frozen scope locator, and CF independently fetched/read lines60-78 at
Source5bc639bb6b72d3c2ec828b65b296dc59139b054b, path
research_notes/owner_goal_20261016/parity_logarithmic_bulk_raw_layer_7cda51_bff6dc/
PARITY_LOGARITHMIC_BULK_UNIFORM_RAW_COEFFICIENT_BAND_JOINT_AUTHOR.md.
It explicitly says natural logarithm, the stated cutoff and exact ceil
range. CF did not read that whole proof, its new working, or independently
reissue its acceptance. Historical candidate wording in that old snapshot
is not used to infer its current review state. No full-library absence
or coverage claim is made beyond the listed scope data.

Put M0=2^1000, C=2^100000. The new UNFROZEN scope, received only as Root's
explicit parameter interface, is integer m>=M0 with

 n=largest even integer <=m-2,  q=2n-2,  D=d-q,
 mu=m^(1/100),
 L=q+ceil(D/mu),  U=q+floor(D/2)=floor((d+q)/2).     (1)

D in (1) is the new residual degree d-q; it is NOT the different carrier
dimension also denoted D in the old log proof. Only the same d,j,m and
COMMON readout are compared. All endpoints in this note retain their
actual ceil/floor and q shift.

## Exact common-cutoff union, conditional on the new whole PASS

For every m>=M0, q is 2m-6 for even m and 2m-8 for odd m. Consequently
q>=0, q+1<=2m, and D>=m^2/2. Also d>=m^2/2 and

 m/mu=m^(99/100)>=2^990>=16.

Thus both D/mu and d/mu are at least8m. In particular

 L>=q+D/mu>6m,
 L<=q+D/mu+1<=d/mu+2m<=(5/4)d/mu.                 (2)

The candidate interval is nonempty: mu>=1024 and D>=5 give
ceil(D/mu)<=D/1024+1<=D/2-1<=floor(D/2).

Let B=ceil(10000d/ln m). Since ln m=100ln(mu)<=100mu,

 10000d/ln m>=100d/mu>L,
 hence L<B.                                        (3)

For m>=C, ln m>=100000ln2>50000 (ln2>1/2 by its integral).
Therefore

 B<=ceil(d/5)<=floor(d/2)<=U,                        (4)

where d>=5 suffices for the middle ceiling/floor comparison. Also
B<=ceil(d/4), so the log-upper interval already contains both quarter
bulk and terminal; directional is contained in initial. Thus BEFORE the
new candidate is accepted the listed common-cutoff coverage is exactly

 [0,6m] UNION [B,d].

IF the candidate whole truly passes, (3),(4) show actual overlapping
integer intervals [L,U] and [B,d], not merely an asymptotic overlap.
Their union is the single upper interval [L,d]. The conditional coverage is

 [0,6m] UNION [L,d],          m>=C.                 (5)

Relative to those listed accepted inputs, the exact net added integer set
is [L,B-1], a nonempty interval. The remaining large-m hole is exactly

 [6m+1,L-1].                                       (6)

It is nonempty by (2). This is a gap in what these stated results imply,
not a counterexample or claim of nonpositivity. Neither [0,d] nor the
parent trace/Goal follows from the conditional upper union (5).

## Cutoffs must not be silently lowered

Write T=ceil(99999d/100000) and h=floor(m/6). Relative ONLY to the inputs
listed here, and retaining the same conditional premise when applicable:

| m regime | Coverage after the hypothetical new PASS | Remaining uncovered integers |
|---|---|---|
| m>=C | [0,6m] union [L,d] | [6m+1,L-1] |
| M0<=m<C | [0,6m] union [L,U] union [T,d] | [6m+1,L-1] and [U+1,T-1] |
| 10000<=m<M0 | [0,h] union [T,d]; candidate inapplicable | [h+1,T-1] |
| 7<=m<10000 | [0,h]; candidate inapplicable | [h+1,d] |

For M0<=m<C the candidate adds exactly [L,U] to the listed old intervals.
There is a genuine second gap: m>=16 gives q<=2m<=d/4 and hence
U<=5d/8, whereas T>=99999d/100000. Their difference is at least
(37499/100000)d>2 here. Thus the terminal interval cannot substitute for
the unavailable common-cutoff log/quarter results. The ranges below M0
are a scope inventory, not a finite-m proof or a computation. For m<7,
this input list supplies no guaranteed interval; no global absence is
inferred. Other unprovided accepted theorems could change that inventory.

## At most two next arrows for the mathematical lead to choose

1. To close the common large-m hole, a genuine SAME-COMMON coefficient
   estimate is needed for J=j-q in
   [6m+1-q,ceil(D/mu)-1]. A scalar/pointwise state margin or an unproved
   relative-stability/deficit assumption alone does not give that arrow.
   Reuse or a new proof may supply it, but this note supplies neither.

2. To extend a single upper interval to all m>=M0, a valid coefficient-level
   upper-half result [ceil(d/2),d] at that cutoff would suffice: its left
   endpoint is at most U+1, so integer adjacency closes the second gap.
   This is a precise sufficient future obligation, not a claimed theorem.
   Merely lowering the old log cutoff while keeping its formula need not
   suffice: for smaller m its B may exceed U+1 or even d.

No third direction or scalar variant is opened. A decides priorities;
the candidate proof and its true nonauthor review remain untouched.
This local status note is not an accepted band, Source event, author vote
or permission to append13. Any later persistence request needs its real
scope and ordinary publication route. Parent OPEN and old false ending
remain; no FINAL permission is asserted.
